4903:soul:2090.reviewedBy: Codex API-priority direct dependency split and state tests
4903:soul:2090.rationale: 首次出战的第一项红伤上限、当前高体弱化/未触发重授清异常、低体先制/威力、已知零红吸取、完整红伤阈值和未高红回末强化逐项真实验证。当前6次重触发截止、红上限单位、MISS零红资格与100%基数4个问题保持单体待答，不延期豁免。
4903:soul:2090.singleBehavior: 当前首次出战次数1授2回合maxHP25%红伤上限，固定不受该上限；前五次真实重授不虚增出战次数；严格高/低于半体、逐项弱化实际成功、失败清异常、低体技能先制1及攻击威力倍、明确满体目标零红百分比吸取与理论魂印回复、单次完整红高于300吸取maxHP/3、当回合没有高红则战阶特攻速度各1。
4903:soul:2090.deferredBehavior: 真实第二次及以后出战次数、依API出战次数依次触发等量的六项登场效果；真实多次出战重授/保留/过期与截止生命周期。当前不明的重新触发计数不算延期。
4903:soul:2090.trigger: 自身登场时，根据本场战斗自身的出战次数，依次触发等量的下列效果

success.name: 4903真实2090首次出战只授第一项两回25%红伤上限，固定50不受限且第三回实际到期
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090首次出战只授第一项两回25%红伤上限，固定50不受限且第三回实际到期',()=>{const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{spd:1},bStats:{spa:9999},loadout:[20155,14102,20082,29352,38393]});turn(s,20155,10716);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),2250);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,2200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.capUntil,2);turn(s,20155,20117);turn(s,20155,10716);assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>2250);});

success.name: 4903真实2090高体回初只弱攻特攻速，任一项实际下降即成功，全部失败才刷新首次登场并清异常
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090高体回初只弱攻特攻速，任一项实际下降即成功，全部失败才刷新首次登场并清异常',()=>{for(const mode of['success','partial','immune']){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;if(mode==='partial'){s.fighters[1].stages.atk=-6;s.fighters[1].stages.spa=-6;}if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'免弱');turn(s,20155,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,mode==='immune'?2:1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],mode!=='immune');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spe,mode==='immune'?0:-1);}});

success.name: 4903真实2090实际首次出战不因弱化失败重授而虚增出战计数，前五次真实刷新，第六次明确Q001回滚
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090实际首次出战不因弱化失败重授而虚增出战计数，前五次真实刷新，第六次明确Q001回滚',()=>{const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true});timer(s,1,'免弱');for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){turn(s,20155,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,r+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.capUntil,r+1);}assert.throws(()=>turn(s,20155,null),/Q-4903-001/);assert.equal(s.round,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,5);});

success.name: 4903真实2090严格低于半体才技能先制1与威力加100%，等于半体不弱化也不加先制或威力
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090严格低于半体才技能先制1与威力加100%，等于半体不弱化也不加先制或威力',()=>{for(const hp of[4499,4500,4501]){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp});let power;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)power=c.power;},()=>turn(s,14102,null));assert.equal(power,hp<4500?100:50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,hp<4500?1:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spe,hp>4500?-1:0);}});

success.name: 4903真实2090严格高于300完整红伤才理论吸取3000，300不吸且回末特攻速度各一；临终过量红也按完整伤害判断
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090严格高于300完整红伤才理论吸取3000，300不吸且回末特攻速度各一；临终过量红也按完整伤害判断',()=>{for(const red of[300,301]){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0){c.minimumDamage=red;c.minimumAfterReductions=true;}},()=>turn(s,14102,null));assert.equal(sum(s),red);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),red>300?3000:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,red>300?4000:1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,red>300?0:1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spe,red>300?0:1);}const a=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1,aStats:{atk:9999}});turn(a,14102,20117);assert.ok(sum(a)>300);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,4000);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,0);});

success.name: 4903真实2090已命中零红且目标满体时吸取100%共同明确9000百分比，免粉仍理论回复；技能命中封锁不封魂印
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090已命中零红且目标满体时吸取100%共同明确9000百分比，免粉仍理论回复；技能命中封锁不封魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','pinkimmune','sealed']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='pinkimmune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='sealed')timer(s,0,'攻击技能命中效果失效');turn(s,14102,20117);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='pinkimmune'?0:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);}const a=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:1000});timer(a,1,'攻击伤害免疫');assert.throws(()=>turn(a,14102,20117),/Q-4903-005/);assert.equal(a.round,1);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,1000);});

success.name: 4903真实2090实际用出攻击MISS或整招无效低体Q004明确拒绝，控制未用不触发吸取，仍可未高红战阶强化
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090实际用出攻击MISS或整招无效低体Q004明确拒绝，控制未用不触发吸取，仍可未高红战阶强化',()=>{for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')s.fighters[0].counts.nextSkillInvalid=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;if(mode==='control'){turn(s,14102,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,1);}else{assert.throws(()=>turn(s,14102,20117),/Q-4903-004/);assert.equal(s.round,1);}}});

success.name: 4903真实2090同回合第二次正红触及不同上限单位时Q002回滚，低总量重放不误阻塞
success.assertion: test('4903真实2090同回合第二次正红触及不同上限单位时Q002回滚，低总量重放不误阻塞',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{def:high?1:300,spd:high?1:300},bStats:{atk:high?9999:180,spa:high?9999:180}}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&c.m.id===key(10716))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));return r;}};try{if(high){assert.throws(()=>turn(s,20155,10716),/Q-4903-002/);assert.equal(s.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500);}else{turn(s,20155,10716);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1).length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500-sum(s,'attack',1)-50);}}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}}});

souls.description: 自身登场时，根据本场战斗自身的出战次数，依次触发等量的下列效果：|    2回合内自身受到的技能伤害不超过自身最大体力的25%|    2回合内自身造成的攻击伤害提升100%|    2回合内自身抵挡受到的致命一击|    2回合内令对手体力恢复效果减少50%|    2回合内每回合结束吸取对手所有技能1点PP值|    2回合内自身造成的固定伤害、百分比伤害提升30%|若触发次数为6次，则登场时无法触发上述效果|自身体力高于最大体力的1/2时，回合开始时令对手攻击、特攻、速度-1，未触发则重新触发自身的登场效果并解除自身所处的异常状态；自身体力低于最大体力的1/2时，自身所有技能先制+1，攻击技能威力提升100%且造成的攻击伤害为0时吸取对手100%的体力|自身造成的攻击伤害高于300时，吸取对手最大体力的1/3，自身未造成高于300的攻击伤害的回合，战斗阶段结束时自身特攻、速度+1|（boss无效）
